title: Social Skills Improve Business Performance: Evidence from a Randomized Control Trial with Entrepreneurs in Togo
eligible_reason: Randomized controlled trial with a single treatment timing. The only DiD-style column (Table 5, column 3) is xtreg profits_lastmonth_log i.treatment_group##i.post_treatment w_2 w_3 w_4, fe cluster(cohort): a treated-vs-control x post interaction with entrepreneur FE and survey-wave dummies, where post_treatment is common to all entrepreneurs (survey waves after the training). Other columns are ANCOVA regressions with baseline profits and covariates. No unit-specific adoption dates.
design_notes: Panel of entrepreneurs in a Togo business-training program observed in a baseline wave and three follow-up waves (wave 1-4). Treatment = randomized social-skills module (treatment_group). Table 5: cols 1-2 reg profits_lastmonth_log i.treatment_group profits_lastmonth_log_bl act_* w_3 w_4 (+ covariates) if wave>1, cluster(cohort); col 3 entrepreneur-FE DiD with post_treatment. Figure/Table with i.treatment_group##i.wave2 margins. Mediation (medeff) and quantile (qreg2) analyses. Cross-sectional do-file regresses networking outcomes on treatment_group.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: No staggered binary adoption in the reported designs.

specs.exclusion_reason: single common post period (RCT); not staggered
specs.fe: id (xtreg fe) + wave dummies w_2 w_3 w_4

data_files_note: The downloaded package contains code, logs and the online appendix but no data file, although the abstract states that data are available at the article DOI.
screener_notes: Screened from package only. RCT with common treatment timing; 'ft_diff_in_diff' flag refers to the entrepreneur-FE DiD column of Table 5.
